notes.title: Unrivaled Heroes 2.5D Brawler
notes.content: [p][/p][p]      [/p][p][b]Soft Source Publishing and GingerSun Games to enter the upcoming Steam Next Fest with a demo of Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler[/b][/p][p]Singapore – 9th June, 2025 – Dive into battle! GingerSun Games’ Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is excited to participate in the upcoming June edition of Steam Next Fest, starting from 10th June to 17th June, 1AM SGT.[/p][p]Steam Next Fest has always been a platform for players to discover, and experience new, upcoming titles. And for indie developers and publishers alike, it’s an amazing opportunity to reach players from around the world. We’re excited to bring the latest demo of Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler, a proudly Indonesian game, to the Steam Next Fest audience.[/p][p][/p][p]Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is a 2.5D side-scrolling beat-’em-up set inspired by Indonesian folklore and mythology.[/p][p] [/p][p]Game Features:[/p][p]o   With 10+ unique characters to unlock, master the unique skills and abilities of each hero, and adapt to their fighting styles to conquer enemies[/p][p]o   Take on the challenge in co-op mode, with local co-op supported for up till 4 players. As battles intensify, teamwork becomes essential, pushing players to strategize and combine their powers to survive and dominate the battlefield[/p][p]o   Prepare for a challenging battle as you face bosses at the end of each domain[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Play [i]Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler[/i] on [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690830/Unrivaled_Heroes_25D_Brawler/"]Steam[/url][/b][/p][p]View Press Kit [b][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1evw8C2KirmGPFGNK02izphgAtzQ4I9Sc?usp=sharing"]here[/url][/b][/p][p] [/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p][u]About [i]GingerSun Games[/i][/u][/p][p]GingerSun Games is an indie game studio based in Sidoarjo with over 3 years of experience crafting games that prioritize premium visuals and interactive experiences. We want to bring more exciting stories to life with engaging characters and memorable gameplay.[/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p][u]About [i]Soft Source[/i][/u][/p][p]Soft Source is a game publisher based in Singapore. With a penchant for home-grown, Southeast Asian titles, we’re just excited to work on bringing engaging games with standout, stylized visuals to life.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://softsourcepublishing.com"]softsourcepublishing.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][u]Media and KOL Contact[/u][/p][p]Natalyn Soh | Community and PR Executive at Soft Source[/p][p][url="mailto:natalyn@softsource.sg"]natalyn@softsource.sg[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]© 2025 Gingersun Games.
